description: This file is a shell script configuring GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system events related to hotspot and GRE tunnel setup.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events for snooper logs by enabling circuit and remote snooper.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from PSM database for GRE and hotspot settings.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates GRE tunnel interfaces, configures network bridges, and sets up virtual interfaces.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets system events related to hotspot keepalive parameters and enables logging.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for network traffic filtering and forwarding.
